NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.49 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.49
• 语音输入支持点击录制鼠标侧键，按一次开始，再按一次结束。 • 新增与智能框选侧键的冲突提示，保留原快捷键和语音设置。 • 语音未能插入输入框时自动复制结果，可直接粘贴。 • 移回功能中心会关闭功能及快捷键，重新添加保持关闭，保留原内容和配置。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.49
• Voice Input supports recording a mouse side button: click once to start and again to finish. • Conflicts with Smart Selection side buttons are explained while existing shortcuts and voice settings are preserved. • When speech cannot be inserted into a text field, the result is copied for manual pasting. • Removing a tool turns it and its shortcuts off. Re-adding keeps it off and preserves its content and preferences.
